_comment: F7: a finished event, completed by the last capture through Vue's Complete event confirmation. Twelve players in three groups, every scorecard scored through 18 from a fixed seed; published, unlocked until that capture. Every game is a buy-in (pool) game as Vue's event game forms create them, $10 a player each: net Skins (pot split by skins won), net Stroke Play paying $60/$40/$20, and Team Stroke Play (groups as teams, two net balls, one 1-18 pot, winner takes all). Only pool games, so every Pot row in Vue's buy-ins-collected settlement is a real pool payout. The seed is chosen so the Stroke Play top three and the winning team are untied and the skins divide the Skins pot evenly. Dated a week before the browser's fixed date and built before every other fixture, so it never shows in the recent scorecards, recent events or recent partners lists other captures show.
name: Chambers Bay Cup
